provenance.author: Vincent Russo
provenance.method: by hand: the symmetric-subspace basis |00>, |11>, (|01> + |10>)/sqrt 2, coefficients fitted exactly

compute.hardware: Apple silicon laptop, one core; direct construction, no search

notes: |sqrtT>^2 lies in the symmetric subspace Sym^2(C^2), spanned by the stabilizer states |00>, |11> and (|01> + |10>)/sqrt 2, so chi <= 3 at two copies for every single-qubit state. With the exact Galois lower bound 3 the cell is settled, chi(|sqrtT>^2) = 3, the generic two-copy value (Lovitz and Steffan, arXiv:2110.07781), one more than the T state's 2. The numerical rank-2 exclusion over the 60 two-qubit states (research survey, 2026-10-17) has closest approach 0.986 to the parallel threshold; the lower bound filed is exact instead. Coefficients in Q(zeta_16, sqrt 2), solved by fit_coeffs in the cyclotomic field; the identity is checked symbolically. Implied gamma log_2(3)/2 = 0.7925 against the published 1/2.
